note.en: OAuth with pre-registered client, CIMD or DCR, in that order. `opencode mcp auth <name>`.
note.pt: OAuth com cliente pré-registrado, CIMD ou DCR, nessa ordem. `opencode mcp auth <nome>`.

plans.pt: Open source, sem restrição de plano.

limits.en: Remote servers must speak Streamable HTTP.
limits.pt: Servidores remotos precisam falar Streamable HTTP.

limits.en: Local servers take one `command` array (program + arguments) and `environment` instead of `env`.
limits.pt: Servidores locais usam um único array `command` (programa + argumentos) e `environment` no lugar de `env`.

limits.en: Older configs keep servers directly under `mcp` with `enabled`; current ones use `mcp.servers` with `disabled`.
limits.pt: Configs antigas põem os servidores direto em `mcp` com `enabled`; as atuais usam `mcp.servers` com `disabled`.

methods.template:
{{#isRemote}}opencode mcp add {{name|shell}} --global --url {{url|shell}}{{#headerList}} --header {{key}}={{value|shell}}{{/headerList}}{{#oauth}}
opencode mcp auth {{name|shell}}{{/oauth}}{{/isRemote}}{{^isRemote}}opencode mcp add {{name|shell}} --global{{#envPairs}} --env {{.|shell}}{{/envPairs}} -- {{command|shell}}{{#args?}} {{args|shell}}{{/args?}}{{/isRemote}}
